taxonomyNote: Reported in Texas literature under the name Cyrtodactylus scaber (NatureServe).
behavior: A sample from Galveston, Texas in mid-September showed hatchlings, juveniles and adults present.
habitat: Rock piles and escarpments in the native range; in Texas, the upper walls of dockside buildings, inside and out.
range: Native from Egypt and the Middle East to western India; established through introduction in Texas (Galveston shipping docks), Arizona, California and Nevada (Center for North American Herpetology, citing SSAR); NatureServe lists Arizona and Texas as exotic.
